scripts.dev:staging: if [ ! -f ../../.env.staging.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.staging.local.'; exit 1; fi; vite dev --mode staging --port 3000
scripts.dev:production: if [ "$ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DEBUG" != "true" ]; then echo 'Refusing to connect the local web app to production.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f ../../.env.production.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.production.local.'; exit 1; fi; vite dev --mode production --port 3000
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc dist/server/index.js --assets dist/client --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc dist/server/index.js --assets dist/client --env production
scripts.validate:deployment:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc dist/server/index.js --assets dist/client --dry-run --env staging
scripts.validate:deployment:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc dist/server/index.js --assets dist/client --dry-run --env production
